# Gharial, 2026-10-21/22 (eqoa harvest recordings; claude-notes/offence-sandstorm-20261022.md):
# a line a condition: the class, the weapon's DMG, its condition (cur/max hit points), 2 when
# two-handed else 1, the STR and DEX held through it (stat channel bytes 0 and 12), the target's
# level (35g the Gharial, a creature), then every swing in the order it came. Procs (a second hit
# in the same ms), damage shields (in the ms the target hit back; and the shadow knight's Shroud
# of Hate, 52 and 53, where his broken blade's roll is at its floor) and casts are left out, and
# so are conditions of fewer than 8 swings.
